title: tests/kernel/test_fips_gate.c: verify ops fail when wolfCrypt not OPERATIONAL
description: Kernel test module that verifies wolfkm correctly refuses all crypto operations when wolfCrypt is not in FIPS OPERATIONAL state. Test approach: if wolfCrypt exports a test function to force non-OPERATIONAL state (e.g. wc_RunAllCast_fips for error injection), call it, attempt a wolfkm crypto operation, verify it returns -EACCES, then restore OPERATIONAL state. If wolfCrypt has no injection API, test by unloading wolfcrypt.ko and checking that wolfkm refuses to load (module_init returns -ENODEV).
notes: This test may be partially blocked by HUMAN_TASK_002 (wolfcrypt.ko API audit) — if wolfCrypt has no FIPS injection API, document that in a human_tasks file.
design: Check wolfCrypt headers for any FIPS state injection API before writing. If no injection API exists, the test is: (1) modprobe -r wolfkm; (2) modprobe -r wolfcrypt; (3) attempt insmod wolfkm.ko without wolfcrypt loaded; (4) verify insmod fails with ENODEV. This may need to be implemented as a shell test in run_kernel_tests.sh rather than a .ko. See DESIGN.md §test_fips_gate.
